dedupe_keys.name: usaid flood response post intervention water point survey mulanje malawi 2019 to 2020 openwashdata

description: This openwashdata package publishes post-intervention monitoring data for rural water points in the Mulanje district of Malawi, collected with the mWater mobile platform during the USAID Flood Response programme in 2019 and 2020, after flood recovery works on the water points. Enumerators assessed each water point on site: its physical condition with photographs, pump operation, the time and effort needed to pump a standard volume, chemical quality (arsenic, ammonia, fluoride, nitrate, free chlorine and total dissolved solids), pH, temperature, turbidity, and E. coli counts per 100 millilitres with confidence intervals and a risk class. Coverage is one district, point by point. Access is a public GitHub repository packaged as an R data package with CSV and spreadsheet exports, archived on Zenodo, under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence as the README read on 2026-09-28 states. Caveats: it covers one programme's water points over two years, sampling was not designed as a census of all sources, and results reflect conditions after specific interventions. It supports resilience and recovery analysis of rural water supply after floods, calibration of condition and failure assumptions for handpumps and boreholes, and emergency response planning for water points in flood-prone districts. No related Malawi water point record is catalogued yet.
